shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
anthropomorphic figure with headdress/hair mass at top
incised horizontal bands of repeated pattern near the lower part
raised outlines defining rounded body forms
object displayed upright in a museum interior
justification: Both are upright grey stone reliefs whose imagery centres on an anthropomorphic form with a distinct mass at the head, with horizontal banded patterning lower down and a disc-like circular element, which is about as specific as the correspondence gets. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a frontal, symmetrical, heavily weathered boulder with coarse curvilinear incisions on a rounded three-dimensional body, while B is a flat rectangular slab bearing two crisply modelled figures in strict profile with fine linear detail of dress, hair and beard, so the compositional schemes and the carving hands are unrelated.
